## Summary

Hold the long adjustment bolt steady while turning the lock nut to secure it. [t1138]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

2. Turn the lock nut to secure it.

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] When adjusting height, hold the larger adjusting nut and turn the main bolt instead of just turning the whole assembly. [t1138]
